_planNotes.angle: Angle 2 — 'proof = confidence' (Pain state #2, the kid whose confidence is shrinking). Mechanism = UMS Principle 4: two kinds of confidence — praise is fragile (on loan), data-built confidence is durable. PROOF for this angle is the 'shy kid' case study + the visible-numbers mechanism + credentials + the guarantee — it deliberately does NOT use the Wang 224% stat (that proves velocity/jump, not confidence).
_planNotes.copyRule: BY REFERENCE, VERBATIM. The role-slot cards (A1–A4, B1–B2, C1–C2, D1–D2, E4) bind copy by id into copy-library.json via copyRefs/hookRef — no inline text, every word traces to a magnet Cody wrote; verbatimGuard is CLEAN on all of these. The 'cut more magnets' upgrade (scripts/lib/copy-library.mjs) splits each ad body into bodyPara/bodyLine units, so proof/blame/offer lines are now referenceable too. Multi-field templates (E1 meet-coach, E2 quote-card, E3 cluster-31 credentials, F1 stat-reveal, F2 cluster-32, BR1 logo-sting) keep templateData by design (per SKILL.md). KNOWN EXCEPTION: E3's credential card carries 3 proof/claim labels (the NFL names + 'the same credential D1 and NFL strength coaches carry') that are verbatim FACTS from AD3 reformatted as uppercase card labels, so the report-only guard flags them — not a rewrite (proper nouns + a capitalized clause), just not a whole-sentence magnet. 16 of 17 cards trace 100% clean.
_planNotes.layout: Hook cards use the role-upgrade stack: eyebrow (INDIANAPOLIS SPORT PARENTS, white chip, top) → kicker (lead-in, above headline) → headline → subhead. cluster-43 is the stacked-hook template (A4/B1/D2). A hookRef auto-splits a 2–3 segment line across kicker/headline/subhead via splitHook; a copyRefs binds a single magnet to one slot.
_planNotes.media: EVERY creative is media-backed (hard rule 6). Statics set asset.media (./assets/conf-<id>.jpg); the runner injects it as a full-frame bg + legibility scrim + text shadows. Motion sets asset.clip. Distinct source per asset, no reuse.
_planNotes.eyebrow: location = indianapolis → eyebrow auto-anchors 'INDIANAPOLIS SPORT PARENTS' (white chip) on every card; never hand-set.
_planNotes.guaranteeFlag: guarantee role is brand-locked to the canonical wording on F1/F2; renders the canonical string.
_planNotes.status: All 'pending' — re-authored by reference; awaiting approval on the review page. Clear campaigns/multisport-foundations-confidence/edits/ before re-render (stale sidecars override the plan).

angles.name: Proof = Confidence (the kid whose confidence is shrinking) — ad copy series #2

angles.emotionalJob: Name what the parent is actually buying (confidence). End the helplessness of praise that stopped working.
angles.voice: Head-coach-to-parent, declarative, metric-driven. No emoji / exclamation / em dash.
